Baxter develops healthcare solutions focused on saving and sustaining lives. The Software Engineer develops and supports cloud-based vision care products, contributing across architecture, design, development, and sustaining engineering.
Biotechnology

Health Care

No H1B
Responsibilities
As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the research and development of advanced vision care cloud solutions, saving vision for diabetic patients in primary healthcare settings
You will be involved with the entire lifecycle including architecture, design, development, and sustaining engineering for new and existing products
Support new product development and sustaining development for cloud-based products
Build and enhance RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures using C# and .NET technologies
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers, to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Develop high-quality, testable software that meets product, regulatory, and compliance requirements
Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, standups, design reviews, retrospectives, and software demonstrations
Conduct code reviews, maintain technical documentation, and drive software quality, security, and performance standards
Implement automated testing and continuous improvement practices while staying current with emerging web technologies, development frameworks, and industry trends

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 1-2 years of professional, internship, co-op, or project-based software development experience
Experience developing applications using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and SQL, with a strong foundation in writing clean, maintainable code
Exposure to cloud-based applications and a passion for learning how scalable, high-availability enterprise software is built and supported
Understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, including hands-on experience designing, querying, or maintaining data solutions
Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including testing, documentation, code reviews, version control, and maintainability
Familiarity with microservices architecture, API development, and modern testing approaches such as unit, integration, or performance testing
Experience working in Agile environments and exposure to CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, or other build and deployment automation tools
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with a self-driven mindset and eagerness to learn new technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized environments
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We cannot sponsor or transfer employment visas at this time

This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.
